tasks.title: Promote the four staged tables into app/schema.sql
tasks.dod: init_store applies app/schema.sql with the four tables and idx_outcomes_event_id twice to a fresh file, and schema tests for the unique event_id and outcome CHECK pass.

tasks.title: Add store functions for deliveries, events, outcomes and rejections
tasks.dod: Store unit tests pass for saving deliveries, events (INSERT OR IGNORE), rejections and outcomes, and for has_final_outcome treating failed and dry-run rows as not final.

tasks.title: Verify the HubSpot v3 signature in a pure function
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass: a correctly signed synthetic delivery verifies, and a changed body, URI, timestamp or a missing signature fails.

tasks.title: Normalize the orgnr and detect foreign registrations
tasks.dod: Parametrized unit tests pass for every orgnr shape (plain, spaced, NO prefix, MVA suffix, invalid) and for foreign prefixes and countries.

tasks.title: Resolve won stages from the pipeline configuration
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass: closed stages with probability 1.0 are won in any pipeline; lost, open and unknown stages are not.

tasks.title: Map a deal and its line items to a Draft order with percentage discounts
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass for one order line per line item, deal currency, external key hubspot-deal-<id>, and per-unit discounts converted to a two-decimal percentage with a rounding flag.

tasks.title: Decide skip and hold outcomes as pure rules
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass for each skip and hold reason, the foreign-before-invalid precedence, the not-won-first order and the several-customers hold.

tasks.title: Build the HubSpot client with pacing, 429 wait and GET retries
tasks.dod: MockTransport tests pass for the 429 wait then success, 404 as DealNotFound, bounded GET retries on 5xx and the 15 s timeout.

tasks.title: Build the PowerOffice client with token, lookups and creates
tasks.dod: MockTransport tests pass for one token refresh on 401, POST not retried on 5xx or timeout, and exact reference equality on the order search.

tasks.title: Process one event from the current deal state to one outcome
tasks.dod: Processor tests with fake clients pass for AC-01, AC-02, AC-03, AC-09, AC-11, AC-13, AC-18 and AC-20, including zero POSTs in dry run.

tasks.title: Process a delivery's events under one lock, counting duplicates and failures
tasks.dod: Processor tests pass for the AC-16 mixed delivery, a repeated delivery counted as duplicates, failed-then-retried events, held events kept, and two concurrent deliveries of one deal creating one order.

tasks.title: Add the webhook endpoint: verify, persist, acknowledge, schedule
tasks.dod: TestClient tests pass: valid delivery returns 204 and persists before processing; missing or mismatched signature returns 401 with a rejection row; a non-array body returns 400; a repeated delivery stores one event row; the smoke test stays green.

tasks.title: Replay recorded deliveries byte for byte to the local endpoint
tasks.dod: Tests pass showing each recorded delivery is posted in order with its original headers and byte-identical body, and acknowledged and rejected responses are counted.

tasks.title: Print the run report from the store
tasks.dod: Tests pass for the report counts per last outcome and the exact event=<id> deal=<id> outcome=<o> reason="<r>" line format from a temporary store.

tasks.title: Load config once and wire serve, replay and report commands
tasks.dod: Tests pass for config errors that name missing variables without values, DRY_RUN defaulting to true, and main([]) still returning 0.
